proposals.rationale: In § 1910.157(c)(4), 'except during use' is an explicit exception embedded in the baseline requirement that extinguishers be kept in their designated places at all times (C0001). Under the relationship pass, an explicit exception must be emitted as a separate exception unit qualifying its baseline rule with relation exception and modality not_stated.

context_quotes: (4) The employer shall assure that portable fire extinguishers are maintained in a fully charged and operable condition and kept in their designated places at all times except during use.
fields.summary: Portable fire extinguishers are not required to be kept in their designated places during use, acting as an exception to the requirement that they be kept in designated places at all times.

proposals.rationale: In § 1910.157(a), the source states that paragraph (d) does not apply to extinguishers provided for employee use on the outside of workplace buildings or structures. C0000 is a distribution requirement under paragraph (d)(2). C0003 is edited from a standalone exemption with an overly broad quotation into an exception qualifying C0000 with relation exception and modality not_stated.
proposals.quote: Paragraph (d) of this section does not apply to extinguishers provided for employee use on the outside of workplace buildings or structures.

fields.summary: Paragraph (d) selection and distribution requirements, including Class A distribution under § 1910.157(d)(2), do not apply to extinguishers provided for employee use on the outside of workplace buildings or structures.

observations.quote: (2) Where the employer has an emergency action plan meeting the requirements of § 1910.38 which designates certain employees to be the only employees authorized to use the available portable fire extinguishers, and which requires all other employees in the fire area to immediately evacuate the affected work area upon the sounding of the fire alarm, the employer is exempt from the distribution requirements in paragraph (d) of this section.
observations.rationale: This provision is a standalone exemption with modality not_required. Under extraction guidance, standalone not-required is an exemption without a forced target and is already properly captured in C0002.

observations.quote: Where extinguishers are provided but are not intended for employee use and the employer has an emergency action plan and a fire prevention plan that meet the requirements of 29 CFR 1910.38 and 29 CFR 1910.39 respectively, then only the requirements of paragraphs (e) and (f) of this section apply.
observations.rationale: This scoping limitation restricting application to paragraphs (e) and (f) is already represented in the scope_text and scope_quotes of C0001.

observations.quote: provided that such systems meet the respective requirements of § 1910.158 or § 1910.159, that they provide total coverage of the area to be protected, and that employees are trained at least annually in their use.
observations.rationale: These conditions qualify the alternative permission in § 1910.157(d)(3) to substitute standpipe systems or hose stations for Class A extinguishers. Because the baseline permission is not an existing claim in the supplied draft, this qualification cannot be linked and remains unresolved.
